prompt: Single continuous shot. Rice absorbing golden broth in a wide pot, steam rolling. Shredded chicken folded through in ribbons, corn scattered, cream cheese dolloped and melting into streaks as the spoon turns. Money shot: the dish emerging from the oven bubbling at the edges, a serving spoon pulling up a stretchy, creamy scoop with cheese pulling in strands, steam backlit gold. Final beat: five plates being filled in a row down a family table. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the folding stir, then the bubbling edge. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music. Three short bold white sans-serif title overlays appear one at a time in the lower third, synced to the action, reading exactly: PASSO 1 while the rice absorbs the broth, then PASSO 2 while the chicken and corn are folded in, then PASSO 3 when the spoon lifts the cheesy scoop. They are clean graphic title overlays composited over the image, NOT text written on any object, wall, board or packaging in the scene. No other words, letters or writing appear anywhere in the video.
caption:
Jantar pra família inteira numa travessa só — arroz cremoso que vai do fogão pro forno.
🧾 2 xíc. de arroz · 1 peito de frango desfiado · 1 lata de milho · requeijão · queijo · caldo de galinha
1. Cozinha o arroz no caldo. 2. Mistura frango, milho e requeijão ainda quente. 3. Queijo por cima, forno até borbulhar.
💡 Requeijão no arroz QUENTE derrete parelho — frio, empelota. Salva pro jantar de quarta 📌
